Metro Atlanta Web Design Services

EverBuilt Studio provides web design services for small businesses in metro Atlanta, delivering websites with $0/month hosting and no subscription or lock-in. Our websites are built for owner-run local service businesses, such as landscaping, roofing, contractors, and salons, with ownership and files handed over upon completion.

What you get

Free homepage remake, Launch package $2,950, Signature package from $7,500

Why Everbuilt Studio

Our goal is to provide small businesses with a professional online presence without the burden of recurring hosting fees. By handing over the website files, we ensure that our clients have full control and ownership of their website.

FAQ

What type of businesses do you serve? We serve owner-run local service businesses in metro Atlanta, such as landscaping, roofing, contractors, and salons.

Do I own my website? Yes, you own your website outright, with all files handed over to you upon completion.

Next step: Get a free homepage remake by visiting everbuiltstudio.com
